text: I used to go to this clinic over the years for treatment of a rotator cuff issue. Been here in Pattaya 12 years, Thai Wife and Thai Daughter. Yesterday I went for an uregent problem but was told the clinic "no longer treats international patients". In essence only treat Thai Nationals. Clear discrimination, Doctors take an oath to serve, to "do no harm". Rejecting prior international patients such as myself who received Cortisone Shots and Ultrasound srvices in the past at this clinic is clearly discrimination. I was shocked and angry. I have the paper notice they gave to me stating that since april 2024 they no longer treat international people. Disgraceful. The paper states its due to " the loss of data in language translation may lead to a fetal situation". This is simply ridiculous as the receptionist and the Doctor are both fluent in English.

text:
I had knee surgery to insert a metal plate in my right knee with Dr. Rutsorn at Muang Hospital. He's a polite, kind, and friendly doctor.
Eight months later, I could only bend my knee very little, so I decided to see him at his clinic for advice. He gave me a referral letter for further treatment.
While waiting for the clinic to open, there were many patients waiting, both Thai and foreign.
When it was almost time for the clinic to open, everyone lined up in order, greeting and inquiring about each other's conditions in a warm and friendly manner.
The clinic staff were lovely and provided excellent service, attentive to every patient.
The treatment cost was not expensive.
I'm so glad there's such a skilled doctor taking care of people.
For those suffering from bone and joint ailments, I highly recommend this clinic.
